title: Not Eligible | EU 261 | Employee AC
description:
Customer is an Air Canada employee travelling on an employee booking. Employee bookings are NOT eligible for compensation under ANY regime (EU 261, APPR, ASL). Validates that DDS correctly detects the employee booking flag in the PNR and returns Not Eligible regardless of delay duration or controllability. Mirrors APPR employee test (TC_043) but under EU 261.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (AC employee), 1 leg AC operated LHR?YYZ. Employee booking flag: TRUE in PNR. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 16:00, Actual arrival 20:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: 42 (Controllable). Booking type: Employee/staff travel.
